# Keyboard shortcuts

> generated from `src/input.ts` (the same table the in-app menu → "Shortcuts" panel renders) · v0.11.44-2026-08-28

## Edit

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl+Z` | Undo |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Z` / `Ctrl+Y` | Redo |
| `Ctrl+Shift+C` | Copy merged (composite) |
| `Ctrl+C` | Copy to clipboard |
| `Ctrl+C ×2` | Press twice = copy merged |
| `Ctrl+X` | Cut to clipboard |
| `Ctrl+V` | Paste as new layer |
| `Ctrl+E` | Merge layer down |
| `Delete` / `Backspace` | Delete selection contents |

## Lasso

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `Enter` | Apply transform |
| `Escape` | Cancel transform |
| `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` / `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` | Nudge float (1 px) |
| `Shift+ArrowLeft` / `Shift+ArrowRight` / `Shift+ArrowUp` / `Shift+ArrowDown` | Nudge float (10 px) |
| `Escape` | Cancel polygon |
| `Enter` | Close polygon |
| `Escape` / `Ctrl+D` | Deselect |
| `Ctrl+A` | Select all |
| `Ctrl+Shift+I` | Invert selection |
| `T` | Transform selection |
| `Ctrl+T` | Transform selection (PWA only; Ctrl+T is taken in a browser tab) |
| `Ctrl+J` / `Shift+D` | Copy selection to float |

## Tools

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `B` | Brush |
| `S` | Shape brush |
| `E` | Eraser |
| `E` | Hold = temporary eraser (release to restore tool) |
| `I` | Eyedropper |
| `G` | Paint bucket (fill tool) |
| `L` | Lasso |
| `H` | Pan |

## Panels

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `C` | Color panel |
| `N` | Layers panel |
| `R` | Reference window |

## View

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `0` | Center canvas |
| `+` | Zoom in |
| `-` | Zoom out |

## Size

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `[` | Size − |
| `]` | Size + |

## Touch gestures

| Gesture | Action |
|---|---|
| Two-finger pinch | Zoom / rotate the canvas |
| Two-finger tap | Undo |
| Three-finger tap | Redo |
